source_note: User supplied Fukui Shimbun result screenshot.

rare_regime_audit.conclusion: The existing Rare-Regime warning did not flag draw 2147 as high risk.
rare_regime_audit.interpretation: The unusual feature was structural concentration rather than an unseen exact state.

crowd.note: Moderately crowd-prone by the exploratory Crowd Agent; actual first-prize winners were 3.

lessons: Do not equate rare with exact-state frequency <=1 only.
Add structural rarity types: max band count >=4, specific-band concentration, upper-band absence, occupied-band count.
Keep empirical and theoretical state probability separate. The flow was empirical rank 24 but theoretical rank 4 for the available Flow category sizes.
Rare-Regime should route to Rare-Type Agents instead of only changing the number of Tail tickets.
No hard exclusion should be added from this single draw.
